ambient: A number is said. It was you.
The addition passes over you and continues downward.
The column is ruled again, one line further on.
description: You are a figure in a column, and the column is being added up by something that will not check its work twice. There is a number above you and a number below you and you are between them, and that is the whole of what you are. The total is going to be correct.
name: The Sum

looks: It goes up out of sight and down out of sight and you are one line of it.
The figures either side of you were probably also people.
It is neat. Somebody rules these.
objects.name: the column

looks: It says a number, and the number is you, and then it says the next one.
It has done this column before and it will do it again afterwards.
objects.name: the one adding

weather: There is no weather in a column of figures, and there never has been.
